data.narrative:
Arena AI is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Pratap Ranade and Engin Ural that has raised $62M to date. Valuation analysis triangulates across a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—all operating in the Defense & Security sector at similar stages.

Two primary valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling uses the $62M in total capital raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $118M. Peer-median benchmarking draws from 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables, including Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B). The median valuation across this cohort is $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B.

The triangulated analysis produces a range of $100M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $559M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Arena AI's relative competitive positioning and revenue traction within a heterogeneous peer set. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively on deployed capital, while peer multiples likely reflect variable investor conviction and defensibility claims across the cohort. Resolution of valuation will depend critically on Arena AI's revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and technical differentiation relative to the identified peer set.
